userDecision: The curved 𪜈-frame form c9fc3b, confirmed over the round-8 points leader.
selectionRule: Direct record between the top two plus the study construction tally: c9fc3b beat cfb207 in every primary meeting (2–0–1) and the curved frame led the cross-construction count (10–3 in round 7; assembly 2–1–1 in round 8). Repeat judgments excluded from ranking.

pointsRuleResult.note: Points per comparison in round 8 alone ranks the assembly form first (2.5/4 vs 1.5/4); it beats the two curved forms that beat c9fc3b, a cycle the user resolved against the rule.

findings.bend: Moot. The three curved forms (bend 0.10/0.53/0.77) split evenly: 0.10 vs 0.53 went neither then tie, and 0.77 lost one to each. Round 7’s open bend question closes with no preference.
findings.size: Settled in round 6–7: every leader is a scaled-up form (size 1.05–1.10, tall 1.04–1.08).
findings.construction: Curved 𪜈 frame over the straight assembly: 10–3 across constructions in round 7, and round 8’s cross-construction primaries finished assembly 2–1–1 — the assembly’s two wins were the two curved forms that beat c9fc3b.
findings.bendNote: c9fc3b carries bend 0.77; since bend does not separate, the value is incidental to the selection.

limitations: The comparisons record one reader’s preferences.
Each judgment combines horizontal and vertical text.
Only one of four reversed repeats agreed in round 8 (two of six in round 7).
The top two form a cycle with the other finalists: cfb207 beat both forms that beat c9fc3b, so the points rule and the direct record disagree.
